glossary.definition: (1) "Biological sex" means the biological indication of male and female, including sex chromosomes, naturally occurring sex hormones, gonads, and unambiguous internal and external genitalia present at birth, without regard to an individual's psychological, chosen, or subjective experience of gender.
(2) "HIPAA privacy rule" has the same meaning as in section 3798.01 of the Revised Code.
(3) "IEP" has the same meaning as in section 3323.01 of the Revised Code.
(4) "Parent" has the same meaning as in section 3313.98 of the Revised Code.
